title: Dynamics, Random Products, and Ultrametric Geometry in Kiselman's Semigroup
summary: We study certain dynamical and metric aspects of Kiselman's semigroup $K_n$. The level function $\mathcal{L}$ is introduced and shown to admit a simple description in terms of right multiplication by generators. We show that every sequence of partial products in $K_n$ is eventually constant.
